primitive.relation: one contract, three presentations: X212 x212_longest_cycle is GTBase.walks_paths.seq_longest_cycle (--) c (the Boolean genuine-cycle maximum, by conversion); X10 x10_longest_cycle is its nested view with curried competitor premises (seq_longest_cycle_nestedE, a proved iff); Hom U3 longest_cycle is its and3 view over ALL ucycle competitors (seq_longest_cycle_ucycleE, a proved iff through the size split: a competitor with at most two entries is never longer than a genuine cycle). No symmetry, looplessness or inhabitance premise; no propositional extensionality.

boolean-genuine-cycle-maximum.note: X212's x212_cycle c /\ forall c', x212_cycle c' -> size c' <= size c, with x212_cycle the Boolean seq_cycleb (--) after B10: the body of seq_longest_cycle (--) c, convertible, so B10's frozen X212 longest-cycle certificates still hold by iff_refl.

nested-genuine-cycle-maximum.note: X10's ucycle (--) c /\ 2 < size c /\ forall c', ucycle (--) c' -> 2 < size c' -> size c' <= size c: the nested view of seq_longest_cycle (--) c (seq_longest_cycle_nestedE), a proved iff rather than a conversion; competitors are exactly the genuine cycles.

all-ucycle-and3-maximum.note: Hom U3's [/\ ucycle (--) c, 2 < size c & forall c', ucycle (--) c' -> size c' <= size c] bounds ALL ucycle competitors, degenerate ones included: the and3 view of seq_longest_cycle (--) c (seq_longest_cycle_ucycleE), equivalent because the witness has more than two entries, so a competitor with at most two entries is never longer. The and3 adapter keeps grounding_U3's projections with unchanged types.

upstream_audit.note: Neither MathComp nor coq-graph-theory names a longest cycle of a raw sequence. MathComp supplies ucycle, size, the cardinality bound of duplicate-free sequences (card_uniqP, max_card) and ex_maxnP, used for the conditional existence over a finite carrier. GTBase.walks_paths.seq_longest_cycle reuses B10's seq_cycle / seq_cycleb (genuine cycles: more than two pairwise distinct entries) over an arbitrary relation, with the maximum taken over the whole carrier (length maximality, not inclusion maximality). Digraph X2 longest_dicycle (Digraph.core.dipath.dicycle admits loops and digons) is a distinct admissibility class for a later family; Hom U3 longest_path and fixed-length, Hamiltonian or induced cycles stay separate. Legacy bodies and per-row certificates: meta/migration_reports/longest_cycle.md.
